events.title: Rhythm Bullet Heaven Roguelike Groove Core Demo Now Available on Steam
events.summary: Indie game publisher Gamirror Games has announced that they will publish Groove Core, a rhythm-based bullet heaven roguelike shooter developed by core members of the DICEOMANCER team. A free demo is now available on Steam.Groove Core is a rhythm-based bullet heaven roguelike shooter set in space, played from a top-down perspective.
